Hello Fediverse! 👋

Spectacled is a family of lightweight, open source apps for 📓 Journals, 🗒️ Notes and ✅ Tasks.

Your entries are stored as iCalendar (VJOURNAL/VTODO) and synced over CalDAV with a server you choose, like Nextcloud. No account with us, no proprietary cloud.

📱 Android & iOS, 💻 desktop and 🌐 web

Made by the developer of @jtx@fosstodon.org 

🧪 Public beta coming soon, follow to get the invite!

🔗 https://spectacled.techbee.at
💻 https://github.com/TechbeeAT/spectacled

#introduction #CalDAV #OpenSource
